user_query: trass gmail last 1 month with terms mgm and shipbob

intent.goal: search trass gmail messages from the last month containing terms mgm and shipbob

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.page_id,
    u.workspace,
    u.database_name,
    u.title,
    u.created_time,
    g.subject,
    g.sender_name,
    g.sender_email,
    g.message_content
FROM unified_content u
JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name = 'gmail'
AND datetime(u.created_time) >= datetime('now', '-1 month')
AND (
    (g.subject LIKE '%mgm%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%mgm%' OR g.sender_email LIKE '%mgm%')
    AND
    (g.subject LIKE '%shipbob%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%shipbob%')
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200
